Subject: Phased conversion to usage with safety-net credits — initial plan

Hi Sarah,

Thanks again for taking the call last week. Per our conversation, I pulled together a light proposal for a phased conversion from Starglass's current annual reserved plan to a usage-based model with a rolling safety-net credit to protect against cost volatility during the first 12 months. High-level: 

- Phase 1 (Q4): 25% of traffic on usage; annual commitment reduced by 25% prorated for remaining term.
- Phase 2 (Q1): 50% usage / 50% commit; safety-net credit of 20% applied to overage for first 6 months.
- Phase 3 (Q2 onward): Full usage with standard volume discounts and optional burst pool.

Benefits for Starglass: predictable transition for finance, lower up-front cash outlay, ability to scale without immediate re‑negotiation. We built a simple calculator (attached) that shows modeled spend across adoption curves.

Next steps I suggest: 1) internal alignment on target go-live (2–6 week window), 2) procurement timeline (DocuSign + PO), 3) legal review for the credit wording and co-term alignment.

I've attached a one-pager and the calculator for your finance team. Available for a 30‑minute sync Wed/Thu afternoons PT.

Attachments: Starglass_MA_proposal_v3.pdf (pdf), usage-conversion-calculator.xlsx (xlsx)

Best,
Olga

Redwood Inference

Thanks Olga — this looks promising. A couple of quick questions from our side: 

1) How will the safety-net credit actually be applied? Is it a dollar credit on our invoice, or a percentage rebate applied after the month closes?
2) For co-terming: our fiscal year ends 12/31 — will you prorate the remaining annual commitment if we start the phase mid-quarter?
3) Procurement needs a clear list of contract changes so they can route for approval. Can you provide the exact clause language you expect legal to accept for the credit and conversion triggers?

Tom — we should align on whether we want to start Phase 1 on Sep 1 or Oct 1. Either could work but Sep 1 gives a little more runway to test.

On schedule — we can do Wed afternoon for a quick sync.

Cheers,

Subject: Re: Phased conversion to usage with safety-net credits — initial plan

Sarah — great questions, answered inline below.

> How will the safety-net credit actually be applied?
We propose a monthly percentage rebate applied as a credit on the next invoice. For example, if the safety-net is 20%, and month-end overage nets $50k, you would receive an $10k credit applied to month+1 invoice. The credit tracks only for the first 6 months after you hit Phase 1. We can alternatively structure it as a true-up rebate; I put both options in the attached one‑pager (see 'Credit mechanics' section).

> For co-terming / proration if start mid-quarter?
Yes — we will prorate the remaining annual commitment from your original renewal date to maintain co‑term. That proration approach is already in the calculator.

> Contract clause language?
Attached: a redline-ready paragraph for the safety-net credit and the phased conversion triggers (file: Starglass_MA_proposal_v3.pdf). Marissa — can you add the proposed legal language to the contract draft and flag any non-standard risk?

Proposed next step: Wed 6 Aug 2:30 PM PT — 30 min to walk the team through the model and confirm procurement/PO timeline.

Thanks — Olga
